content.short: Hacken is an end-to-end blockchain security and compliance partner for digital assets.
content.description: Hacken combines blockchain security expertise with AI-driven offensive testing and compliance know‑how to safeguard digital assets. Since 2017, what started as a small team of ethical hackers has evolved into a leading security partner for the blockchain ecosystem, trusted by governments, regulators, institutions, and more than 1,500 adopters. Clients include the European Commission, ADGM, Ethereum Foundation, MetaMask, and major exchanges like Binance, Bybit, OKX, and Crypto.com.
